purpose: Optional bounded CPU metadata observer for an isolated QA VM; never part of the production graphics payload.
lifetime: Detach all hooks, unload script and detach session after the bounded observation. No automatic launch or injection.
preconditions: Verify selected worker context from the actual VM QMP stats, worker/server/QEMU ancestry, exact VM disk and only one VM with this UUID.
Verify this exact native backend hash before relying on its private CPU buffer layout. Refuse any other hash.
Use an isolated QA VM, preserve OS protections; no image readback, GPU operation, resource mutation or wait is performed by this observer.
assembly: Replace the single C_SOURCE token in sidebar-metadata-observer.js.in with json.dumps(the UTF-8 C source) before creating a Frida script. The caller supplies a bounded session and cleanup.
costScope: Native callback body only; excludes attachment/load, interception glue, total system cost and ordinary rendering performance.
coverage: Four direct draw variants; matching 955x614 targets only; at most64 triangle bounds per draw, truncated flag explicit. No full-frame completeness, indirect-draw absence or missing-icon cause is proved.
